_comment: universe_config.json — all tunable parameters. Edit this, never edit screener.py for configuration changes.

llm._comment: LLM provider for stock research. NVIDIA NIM is free (40 req/min). Anthropic is paid. Set provider here, model here, fallback here — no hardcoding.
llm._model_change_note: Switched to meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct 2026-07-08 after live testing showed the larger free-tier models (49B nemotron-super, 70B llama-3.3, 70B llama-3.1) failing 50-100% of the time on this account (timeouts or empty responses) for the full research prompt, while the 8B model succeeded 4/4 in ~3.5s each. This is what was silently blocking every new candidate from getting a usable thesis.
llm._nvidia_models_comment: Automatic NVIDIA fallback chain, tried top-to-bottom on a single call: if a model is down/at capacity/returns empty after its own retries, the next free model is attempted before giving up. Primary (8B) is most reliable on this account; the rest are free endpoints. Edit this list to change the chain — no code change needed.

_alternative_models._comment: Other free NVIDIA models you can switch to by changing model above. Re-test reliability before switching back to a larger model - see _model_change_note.

nz_fif._comment: NZ Foreign Investment Fund threshold. Updated 2026 — was $50K, now $100K.

universe._comment_sp500_core: SP500_CORE list removed. Universe is fully discovered from SEC EDGAR + NASDAQ API. No hardcoded tickers.

scenario_sanity._comment: Caps on LLM-generated 10-year market cap projections. Prevents hallucinated trillion-dollar numbers.

sentiment_data._comment: Controls how much news/Reddit data is fetched and sent to the LLM per ticker.

sector_survival._comment: LLM-driven top-down sector survival map (screener.build_sector_survival_map). One extra LLM call per run. For each Yahoo sector present among this run's candidates + holdings, the LLM decides survives_20yr (HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW) and max_survivors (how many companies stay leaders 15-20yr). HARD VETO: LOW-survival sectors block new buys and recommend exiting existing holdings. The survivor count can only TIGHTEN the per-sector holdings cap, never loosen it above stock_screening.universal.max_holdings_per_sector.

decision_review._comment: LLM self-review of this run's portfolio decisions (screener.review_decisions). One extra LLM call per run. ADVISORY ONLY: attaches review_flag (OK|REVIEW|OVERRIDE) + review_note per ticker and an overall portfolio_note, surfaced in the emails. Changes no verdicts automatically.

t2._comment: Growth leaders. Strong trajectory, not yet T1 quality.

t3._comment: Moonshots. Pre-revenue or early-revenue. Survival is the screen.

sector_gm_thresholds._comment: Sector-adjusted gross margin minimums for T1 gate. Costco has 13% GM and is a T1 compounder.

etf_screening._comment: ETFs screened separately from stocks. ROIC/revenue are meaningless for funds. Expense ratio and AUM are the quality signals.

core_tier._comment: Broad market core ETFs. Your benchmark. Low-cost, deep liquidity, broad exposure.

thematic_tier._comment: Megatrend-aligned thematic ETFs. Bridge position before individual winners are identifiable.
thematic_tier._comment_why_2yr: Avoid newly launched ETFs with no track record. 2yr minimum.

t3_factor_groups._comment: Cap same-factor T3 holdings to avoid correlated moonshot concentration. Update as new themes emerge.

megatrends._comment: Megatrend definitions. Add new categories here — no code changes needed. Claude quarterly review updates scores in data/megatrend_scores.json.
megatrends._scoring_guide: 10=generational 20yr+ tailwind, 9=major 25yr tailwind, 8=clear 15yr tailwind, 7=real but uncertain timing

ai_infrastructure.label: AI Infrastructure
ai_infrastructure.rationale: Generational compute buildout. Every hyperscaler committed. Power, networking, cooling, connectivity semiconductors all structurally undersupplied.

nuclear_renaissance.label: Nuclear Renaissance
nuclear_renaissance.rationale: Clean baseload power is the only 24/7 zero-carbon option. SMR economics improving rapidly. Policy support accelerating globally.

space_commercial.label: Space Commercialisation
space_commercial.rationale: Launch costs falling 10x per decade. Satellite internet, earth observation, in-orbit services, eventual space resources.

synthetic_biology.label: Synthetic Biology
synthetic_biology.rationale: RNA and gene editing platforms address every major chronic disease. Platform economics mean each new drug costs less to approve than the last.

critical_minerals.label: Critical Minerals
critical_minerals.rationale: Energy transition requires 6x more minerals by 2040. Supply chains geopolitically constrained. Strategic for national security.

defense_technology.label: Defense Technology
defense_technology.rationale: Geopolitical fragmentation driving defense budgets up globally. Autonomous systems, cyber warfare, new domains replacing legacy platforms.

aging_demographics.label: Aging Demographics
aging_demographics.rationale: Global 65+ population doubles by 2050. Chronic disease management, longevity medicine, elder care infrastructure all structurally undersupplied.

energy_transition.label: Energy Transition
energy_transition.rationale: Real structural tailwind but higher execution risk and policy dependency than other categories. Winner selection harder.

fintech_inclusion.label: Fintech and Inclusion
fintech_inclusion.rationale: Digital finance has shorter runway than hard-tech megatrends. Winner-takes-most dynamics mean most participants lose.

water_food_security.label: Water and Food Security
water_food_security.rationale: Climate-driven scarcity is structurally real but investment solutions still early stage. Long runway, high uncertainty on individual winners.

megatrend_overrides._comment: Your manual score overrides. These beat everything including Claude quarterly review. Add entries like 'nuclear_renaissance': 10 when you have conviction beyond the base score.
megatrend_overrides._example: nuclear_renaissance: 10 — if you believe NRC licensing acceleration justifies highest score

sharesies_kiwisaver_available._comment: Tickers available in Sharesies KiwiSaver self-select. Update as Sharesies adds/removes options.
